title: Z.AI GLM Coding Plan Support — Design Spec
summary: Approved design for routing all GLM traffic to the Z.AI coding-plan endpoint: zai-coding provider, canonicalized routing, credit estimation, credits analytics API, no Manifest fallback.
notes: Ambiguity resolved: header 'Status: Approved' and 'Decisions locked with user' are ADR-like, but dominant signals are SPEC (path under specs/, H1 'Design Spec', API endpoint + response schema, DB migration DDL, config/env contracts, data flow), so SPEC over ADR; locked=false per ADR-only rule despite Approved status. Filename suffix is NOT SHA-256: no process execution available (hub op:start/ps broken — ENOENT posix_spawn omp binary; no shell tool; no SQLite file usable), so suffix is a deterministic fallback digest = sum of the full POSIX path's 113 ASCII bytes (10670 = 0x29AE, zero-padded to 000029ae). Slug alone is unique in this batch, so no collision risk.
